findings.reason: _reserve_dispatch_batch raises RuntimeError whenever db.in_transaction is true, treating it as caller-owned. But ledger.initialize (strategy_experiment_store.py:296 INSERT, no commit) leaves the default Store connection (strategy_optimizer.py:3384, isolation_level='') inside an open transaction; _ensure_schema calls initialize (1106-1108) after _sync_db resets _initialized_db (1085-1086), and neither dispatch_authorized_ready (962-971) nor run_pass (1002-1040) commits before _dispatch. _persist/store.set (4155) also opens a transaction at pass end that survives into the next pass. Reproduction: real Evaluator (duty 1.0, open), restored partly-unreserved frozen cohort -> first _dispatch_member reaches the guard with in_transaction true and aborts the pass. Breaks restart semantics (baseline reserved via SAVEPOINT and proceeded).

Fallback per-seed path (used when duty<1) calls Evaluator.submit (strategy_encounter_evaluation.py:106-124), whose ledger.reserve goes through _atomic (strategy_experiment_store.py:207-229). When a transaction is already open _atomic only issues a SAVEPOINT, so pool.submit dispatches a worker before any durable commit; the batch path's commit-before-submit invariant is not held here.

evidenceLimits: Bounded read-only review: deterministic diff of strategy_encounter_search.py against studies/reservation_batching_20260930/baseline/production_source/, narrow reads of strategy_experiment_store reserve/pending_sample/_atomic, strategy_encounter_evaluation submit/submit_recovered, check_optimizer_reservation_batching.py and strategy_revision.py, plus one isolated in-memory sqlite3 check that ledger.initialize leaves db.in_transaction True. No end-to-end campaign run, no production or Community database opened, no battles launched, no delegation.
